title: Rum Mixology Class and Craft Cocktails
blurb:
The Moonshine Mixology Class is an island-themed experience where you'll learn to craft 2 tropical cocktails using signature Moonshine. The class includes:

A hands-on lesson to make 2 signature cocktails
A tasting flight of 6 craft island rums
Led by expert mixologists, you'll discover the techniques and secrets behind making perfect island-inspired drinks.
